description: January 3 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 3 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the second decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 3 birthday
paragraphs: What happens when a cardinal earth sign is handed a talker's number? The 3rd of January pairs Capricorn's discipline with the expressive 3, and the Venus sub-ruler of this decan softens the edges further. Around twelve degrees into the sign, the tradition sketches a dry wit, a feel for presentation and an ambition that quite likes an audience.

By noon UTC on January 3, the Sun has normally reached roughly 12° of Capricorn. That places the date in the Capricorn decan that astrologers give to Venus, the second of three. In the middle of Capricorn, from 10 to 19 degrees, Venus acts as sub-ruler, borrowed from Taurus. Birthdays from about January 1 to January 10 tend to soften the Goat's seriousness with an appreciation of comfort, quality and beauty. These Capricorns are often pictured as both ambitious and sensual: they want to build something, and they want it well made and pleasant to live with. Loyalty in relationships is usually strong. Venus can make material security feel especially important. Remembering that enjoyment is part of success, not a reward postponed for later, often brings this decan balance.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 3 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 3rd, you carry a birthday number of 3 in its simplest form. As a supporting number, the day of birth is read as a gift that shows in everyday style rather than in the larger direction of a life. The single-digit 3 is traditionally associated with expression: talking, writing, making things, finding the joke in a heavy afternoon. Its energy is light and spontaneous, often called youthful whatever the person's age. Numerologists tend to suggest that 3s benefit from finishing what they begin, because their ideas are worth more completed than merely sketched in a notebook.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 3 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 3 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 3 is the 3rd day of the year. In most years Aquarius season is under way by January 21, 18 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 3 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year. January 3 is also the birthday of J. R. R. Tolkien (1892), Michael Schumacher (1969) and Greta Thunberg (2003).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 3?
faq.answer: January 3 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 3?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 3 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 3rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 3?
faq.answer: In the Chinese zodiac a January 3 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 3?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 3 birthday are J. R. R. Tolkien (1892), Michael Schumacher (1969) and Greta Thunberg (2003). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
